Exports the detections in the format of Observation.org

Source: R/observation.R
export_observation.Rd

Groups the detections into one record per species and day. BirdNET names are translated into the names of the bird species of Observation.org, which follows the IOC World Bird List with its own lumps and genera (e.g. Corvus cornix is exported as Corvus corone, with the BirdNET name in the notes): every bird of BirdNET v2.4 has a valid name of Observation.org. Classes that are not birds (noise, human voice, frogs, insects...) are left out. Species that IOC has split are translated according to the location when the rule is clear (e.g. Cecropis daurica is Cecropis rufula in Europe) and are reported otherwise.

Usage

export_observation(
  am,
  min_confidence = 0.8,
  min_detections = 2,
  no_doubts_only = FALSE,
  species = NULL,
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  validation = NULL,
  validated_only = FALSE,
  method = "Oído",
  counting_method = "Sin especificar",
  activity = "",
  is_certain = c("auto", "True", "False"),
  notes = NULL,
  language = default_language(),
  equivalences = NULL,
  file = NULL,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

am

An audiomoth object with detections (see analyze_birdnet()). Each record takes the location (lat, lng, accuracy) of the deployment (card) of its recordings, as it is now in am.

min_confidence

Minimum confidence of the detections that count.

min_detections

Minimum number of detections (events) of the species in the day.

no_doubts_only

Count only the detections without another species in the same window.

species

Only these species (scientific or common name of BirdNET, or name of Observation.org).

from, to

Local dates ("2026-10-07" or "07/10/2026") that limit the period.

validation

Use the validation of create_validation(): NULL (default) when there is one, TRUE to require it, FALSE to ignore it.

validated_only

Export only the records validated as correct.

method, counting_method, activity

Fixed values of those columns, checked against the values that Observation.org accepts for birds (in Spanish, as in its import example).

is_certain

"auto" (default: "True" for the records validated by ear and "False" for the rest, since the identification is automatic), "True" or "False".

notes

Text of the column notes. By default "Identified with BirdNET <version>" ("ID mediante BirdNET <version>" when language is Spanish), followed by the best detection of the record.

language

Language of the default notes.

equivalences

Named vector of own equivalences c("BirdNET name" = "Observation.org name"), which take priority. The names must be bird species of Observation.org (or their synonyms).

file

Output CSV. By default <output>/AudioMoth_<ID>_observation.csv.

overwrite

Overwrite the CSV even if it has been edited by hand.

Value

Invisibly, the exported data frame (columns of Observation.org).

Details

Validation. When the records have been checked by ear with create_validation(), the decisions are applied: records marked as not valid are left out, relabelled ones are exported under their new name, and records marked as valid are exported even if they do not meet min_confidence or min_detections (and, by default, with is certain = True).

Hand-edited files. If AudioMoth_<ID>_observation.csv has been edited since it was exported, it is not overwritten (unless overwrite = TRUE): the new export is saved with the date and time in its name. The criteria used are saved next to it, in AudioMoth_<ID>_observation.json.

Examples

card <- system.file("extdata", "example", "card", package = "AudiomothR")
am <- read_audiomoth(card, coordinates = "41.00, -3.00", output = tempfile())
#> 
#> ── AudioMoth FACADE0012345678 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> • Folder: /home/runner/work/_temp/Library/AudiomothR/extdata/example/card
#> • Site of this card: AudioMoth FACADE0012345678 (41, -3; ±698 m; source:
#> argument)
#> • Map: <https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=41&mlon=-3#map=15/41/-3>
#> • Recordings: 16 in 2 days (2026-10-07 to 2026-10-15, Europe/Madrid time)
#> • Audio: 48,000 Hz, gain Medium, 0.7 min in total
#> • 10 with problems: duration < 3 s
#> • Battery: 4.9 V → 4.5 V
#> • Temperature: 11.7 to 34.4 °C
#> • Results in: /tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file233765ab0369
am$detections <- read_detections(system.file("extdata", "example",
  "birdnet_detections.csv", package = "AudiomothR"))
obs <- export_observation(am, min_confidence = 0.5, min_detections = 1)
#> ✔ 3 records (3 species) for Observation.org in
#>   /tmp/RtmpXUCCMs/file233765ab0369/AudioMoth_FACADE0012345678_observation.csv.
#> ℹ Criteria: confidence ≥ 0.5, ≥ 1 detection per species and day.
obs[, c("date", "time", "scientific name", "is certain")]
#>         date  time         scientific name is certain
#> 1 2026-10-07 08:40       Motacilla cinerea      False
#> 2 2026-10-07 09:15            Cettia cetti      False
#> 3 2026-10-07 10:05 Troglodytes troglodytes      False
